title: Complexity Classification of Colouring Problems with Parity Constraints
summary: We study variants of graph colouring with parity constraints. More specifically, we consider $q$-colourings $c\colon V(G)\rightarrow \{1,\dots,q\}$ of a graph $G$ where, for every vertex $v\in V(G)$, the number of neighbours $w$ of $v$ with $c(w)=c(v)$ is restricted to be odd, even, positive, zero or a combination thereof. For every colour $i\neq c(v)$ the number of neighbours $w$ of $v$ with $c(w)=i$ is restricted by a constraint of similar type. Many known colouring problems such as proper colouring, defective colouring, exact defective colouring, odd colouring, and strong odd colouring…
